source.color_interpretation: Graded HDR RGB TIFF, P3 D65 primaries and PQ transfer as documented by official title catalog and filename. Requires real tone mapping for SDR suite.

transformation: Original TIFF RGB48 decoded; acquisition filter scale=1920:1012:flags=lanczos,setsar=1; resulting RGB pixels losslessly stored as FFV1 gbrp16le in 24-frame resumable segments. Container TIFF inputs removed after segment verification; exact fetched TIFF hashes retained. Lossless storage does not undo explicit spatial normalization.
